notes.title: v1.0.6 Hotfix
notes.content:
We have addressed the following issues in this update:

・Fixed a bug where "Switch to previous weapon" button was not working as intended
・Bunch of small bugfixes

We will continue to address other known issues as well.
Thank you for your continued support of Cheaters Cheetah!

notes.title: v1.0.5 Hotfix
notes.content:
We have addressed the following issues in this update:

・Fixed a bug where the game sometimes crashes when joining a lobby in some environments
(If this bug continues to be an issue after the update, please contact us!)
・Fixed a bug where the game gets stuck in the initial loading screen

We will continue to address other known issues as well.
Thank you for your continued support of Cheaters Cheetah!

notes.title: v1.0.4 Hotfix
notes.content:
We have addressed the following issues in this update:

・Applied some more patch to prevent lobbies crashing after a match in certain environments
(If this bug continues to be an issue after the update, please contact us!)
・Fixed a bug where the player data will not get saved in the first session
・Tweaked the matching algorithm

We will continue to address other known issues as well.
Thank you for your continued support of Cheaters Cheetah!
